name: Bombermaid
storyline:
A maid with a beautiful obsession for explosions received a mission from her master: to recover some minerals inside a cave to make beautiful gems.
But her dangerous nature attracted some unwanted attention, by someone determined to protect the place from rogue explosions.
summary:
Bombermaid is a puzzle game with action elements.

Every level is split in two parts: in the first one, you place your bombs to open a path towards the exit, and in the second... everything explodes!
The bombs will explode in order, so your planning needs to consider your movement and placement to avoid getting hit. Reach the exit before the 10 seconds bomb explodes!
